post.youtube_title: White gold three-stone ring, yellow gold prongs
post.caption:
A white gold three-stone ring with yellow gold prongs. Select similar found the center stone's prongs, I Ctrl+clicked the side stones' prongs, and picked yellow gold for all of them. The band stays white in the render.

Try it on your own 3D file at heygema.com
